payload.title: G1: Box pickers in lessons (S)
payload.description:
Lesson steps can ask the student to pick a box (a0..a7) from a picker instead of typing a name.
Acceptance:
- Given a scene with a box picker, when the student picks a box, then the pick is recorded and checked by the scene.
- The picker is keyboard operable and labelled in STE.
- A lesson.yaml can declare it and npm run lesson -- check accepts it.
